title: Fort Smith, Arkansas forensic report details August ransomware attack on city network
summary: A forensic report by PNG Cyber, made public on 19 November, says attackers accessed the city's network from 24 July to 18 August 2026, exfiltrated data and launched file encryption on 16 August. Talk Business & Politics reports the findings confirm Interlock's early-September claim. Police systems remain affected, and the report does not explain how credentials were stolen.
plain: A report on the August attack on Fort Smith's computers says hackers were inside for weeks, stole data and then locked files. Some city and police systems are still not back to normal.
exec: Attackers were in a city network for weeks before encrypting files, and recovery of public services is still incomplete.
action: Review privileged account monitoring and alerting; test that offline backups restore and that endpoint detection covers every system.
date_note: Date is the publication of the report; the encryption attack was on 16 August 2026.

validation.note: Only Talk Business & Politics read, which summarises the PNG Cyber report; the report itself was not read.

review.note: Compared title, dates, exfiltration, police systems and credential-theft gap against the Talk Business article; Interlock confirmation attributed to the outlet; actor blank; single_source accurate
